title.zh: 失效模式：问题可能来自四个阶段
title.en: Failure modes: problems may originate in four stages

subtitle.zh: 成膜、HM Open、Target Etch与Strip必须分阶段诊断
subtitle.en: Diagnose film formation, HM Open, Target Etch and Strip separately

body.zh: 看到最终CD异常，；不能默认问题只来自Target Etch。
body.en: An abnormal final CD; does not automatically mean Target Etch is the only source.

body.zh: 典型症状；• Wafer Map空间异常；• 局部Mask薄弱；•后续缺陷源
body.en: Typical symptoms; • Spatial anomalies in the Wafer Map; • Locally weak Mask; • A source of later defects

body.zh: 典型症状；• 开口不净；• 下层未充分暴露；• CD在HM阶段已漂移
body.en: Typical symptoms; • Incomplete opening; • Insufficient exposure of the underlying layer; • CD has already drifted at the HM stage

body.zh: 典型症状；• 顶部CD变化；• 局部Target过刻/未刻；•侧壁异常
body.en: Typical symptoms; • Top-CD changes; • Local Target overetch / incomplete etch; • Sidewall abnormalities

body.zh: 典型症状；• 表面残留；• 漏电/接触风险；• 后续附着异常
body.en: Typical symptoms; • Surface residue; • Leakage / contact risk; • Abnormal adhesion downstream
Identify the stage; where the anomaly appears
Compare Litho CD; with HM CD
Correlate Tool / Material; Lots and validate the root cause

body.zh: 最终CD异常=Target Etch问题；可能同时来自成膜、Mask Budget或；Edge处理。
body.en: Abnormal final CD = Target Etch problem; It may also originate in film formation, Mask Budget or; Edge treatment.

body.zh: Breakthrough=只有Over-Etch；可能同时来自成膜、Mask Budget或；Edge处理。
body.en: Breakthrough = Over-Etch alone; It may also originate in film formation, Mask Budget or; Edge treatment.

body.zh: Edge Particle =随机缺陷；可能同时来自成膜、Mask Budget或；Edge处理。
body.en: Edge Particle = random defect; It may also originate in film formation, Mask Budget or; Edge treatment.
Retain original Maps, Logs and; cross-section evidence

body.zh: 避免未确认根因就；修改多个步骤
body.en: Avoid changing multiple steps; before confirming the root cause
Return to film formation, HM Open,; Target Etch or Strip

body.zh: 缺陷名称与主导机制会随 Hard Mask材料、Target、图形类型和清洗路线变化。；不能把最终现象直接等同唯一根因。
body.en: Defect names and dominant mechanisms vary with Hard Mask material, Target, pattern type and cleaning route.; The final symptom cannot be equated directly with a unique root cause.
